_comment: Optional. Settings here are merged into every conversational SFT run on top of the model catalog (command-line args like lr=, train_batch_size= and max_seq_len= still win). Empty by default -- add fields such as {"sub_job_configs": [{"job_type": "training", "training_config": {}}]} to change a default for all SFT runs. The "_comment" key is ignored and never reaches the job body.
